TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Rejects the creation of a pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. It reads pricingRuleId and calls ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId). 2. The library retrieves the pricing rule by ID, loads the active pricing rule details, resolves each detail value and validates that the rule exists and is in PAA, PAU or PAD status. 3. It obtains an audit id and the request user, then records audit data and updates the pricing rule status to REJ when the current status is PAA or PAU, or to SYC when the current status is PAD. 4. If detail resolution fails, the pricing rule does not exist, the rule is not rejectable or the status update fails, the library adds an advice with the propagated code and description, and the transaction sets severity EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. When the library returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, the transaction assigns pricingRuleResponse; if the library returns null because an advice was added, the output parameter is not assigned.
